summary.text: Arthur L. Bell, a Democrat, represents House District 103 (Yarmouth) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Yarmouth. The House profile lists membership on the Environment and Natural Resources Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 130th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives retired as the occupation and a B.A. (1974) from Colby College.
It says Bell is married, to Robin Hodgskin, with three children.
